title: Eazhaiyin Sirippil
desc: Kausalya falls in love with a bus driver, Ganesan, working for her father. However, as she strives to navigate her love and wants to marry him, his past is revealed.

title: Unnai Kodu Ennai Tharuven
desc: Surya has been raised to become a patriotic soldier by a brigadier. Surya loves Indu, daughter of an army man. But when she loses her parents due to a terrorist attack, she asks him to leave the army.

title: Oor Mariyadhai
desc: Rathnavelu loves Rasathi, who is in love with Kannan, brother of Veerapandi, an archrival of Rathnavelu. She is forcefully married to Rathnavelu, which leads to the death of Kannan.

title: Naayak
desc: Siddharth and Charan, two lookalikes who are fighting their own battles against evildoers, cross paths and join forces to take down Rawat, a ruthless minister.

title: Thennavan
desc: Thennavan, a successful bureaucrat, is appointed as the Chief Election Commissioner of the country. However, his radical plan to fix the electoral system goes wrong.
